overviewParagraphs: Royal Long An Golf & Country Club represents a different philosophy in Sir Nick Faldo's design portfolio — one centred on environmental integration and sustainability. Located in Long An Province, the course was designed to work with the existing wetland and agricultural landscape rather than imposing a manufactured golf environment onto it.

The result is a layout of genuine natural beauty, where rice paddies, wetlands, and mature vegetation frame the holes throughout the round. The course design rewards strategic thinking and precise iron play, with Faldo's signature emphasis on properly positioned approach shots to reach short-sided pin positions.

An excellent complement to the more dramatic southern Vietnam courses, Royal Long An appeals to golfers who appreciate refined design over visual spectacle, and who want to experience a genuinely different style of championship golf just south of Ho Chi Minh City.

curatorBriefHtml: Royal Long An Golf & Country Club (opened 2023) brings Sir Nick Faldo’s strategic signature design to the western outskirts of Ho Chi Minh City. Set across expansive Mekong-edge parkland roughly 65–75 minutes southwest of District 1, the 7,090-yard Par 72 layout blends wide, manicured Zoysia corridors with winding waterways, dramatic bunker shaping, and bold green contours that reward positional tee shots.

Having played Royal Long An personally, the immediate impression is space, modern polish, and crisp Faldo risk-reward angles. Unlike older, busier Saigon clubs where tee sheets pack tight, Royal Long An’s contemporary clubhouse, unhurried rhythm, and spacious practice facilities make it an ideal addition for returning golfers who have already played VGCC and Long Thanh and want Southern Vietnam’s newest championship test.
Pair Royal Long An with Tan Son Nhat or VGCC while staying in District 1 — AGS schedules early 07:00 AM departures from Saigon to cruise out cleanly and return by mid-afternoon.

scorecard.verdict: Sir Nick Faldo's modern Southern Vietnam masterpiece makes brilliant use of Mekong Delta waterways. Demands crisp iron play and strategic tee shots to avoid penalty hazards.

faqs.q: What style of course did Sir Nick Faldo design at Royal Long An?
faqs.a: Royal Long An (opened 2023) is a modern, spacious parkland championship course (Par 72, 7,090 yards) featuring strategic water canals, bold sculpted bunkering, and undulating greens designed to test approach-shot precision rather than brute length.

faqs.q: How far is Royal Long An Golf & Country Club from central Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Plan for 65 to 80 minutes by private touring vehicle from District 1 in Ho Chi Minh City. Departing around 06:45–07:00 AM avoids peak city exit traffic.

faqs.q: Is Royal Long An suitable for mid-to-high handicap touring groups?
faqs.a: Yes. Faldo built generous landing areas off the tee and multiple tee-box sets, so higher handicaps can keep the ball in play while lower handicappers face real strategic decisions around the water-guarded greens.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Royal Long An?
faqs.a: December through April offers dry, sunny Southern Vietnam weather. During the May–November green season, morning tee times deliver lush fairways and comfortable temperatures before afternoon showers.
